Schwerin Synagogue

Former Synagogue · Schwerin, Germany

A new synagogue was erected for Schwerin's re-established Jewish community on the historic synagogue property and dates from 2008. It stands in the courtyard at Landesrabbiner-Holdheim-Straße 3–5, the renamed section beside the community centre. The Center for Jewish Art records its present use as a synagogue, while the Central Council of Jews in Germany currently lists no worship services at the community. The building therefore survives in Jewish ownership but is recorded as inactive under this dataset's strict status definition. The community's official directory address and telephone number are retained.
